note: Operator drive intents, not raw datagrams. The simulation's DrillSender turns each held drive into signed schema 4 commands on its 100 ms cadence; the MotorReceiver judges every one. Durations are multiples of the 100 ms command cycle. A null drive means no control held (the drill sends stops).
